positioning: Democratized lending for retail borrowers and institutional capital providers
stakeholders: Liquidity Providers (deposit assets into pools; earn trading fees and token incentives; expected 30-50% of total allocation)
Borrowers (access collateralized loans; pay interest; incentivized through reduced rates for early adopters)
Governance Participants (vote on protocol parameters, fee structures, and treasury deployment; hold staked tokens for voting power)
Protocol Treasury (reserves for grants, insurance fund, and liquidity backstops; managed by DAO governance)
economic_design: Floating supply capped at 200M; 50% to LPs, 20% governance, 20% team, 10% treasury. Core team allocation vests linearly over 48 months after a 12-month cliff; investor tokens vest over 24 months with 6-month cliff.
legal_design: Decentralized governance with legal entity for regulatory liaison; US-focused compliance

team.description: Former financial engineers from lending platforms; 15+ person core team

token_purpose: Decentralized lending protocol enabling peer-to-peer loans with algorithmic interest rate discovery. Provides liquidity providers with sustainable yield through collateralized lending.
technical_design: Rust-based smart contracts on Solana for high throughput; dedicated sequencer for MEV protection; audited by Trail of Bits; hardware security modules for key management
gov_structures: Tiered voting: token-weighted DAO with quorum requirements; core team interim guidance; all insider token allocations subject to vesting schedules enforced by smart contract timelocks
